about: Acceptance gates for a new MRZ model, from the M3 research (own-mrz-model). A model replaces Doubango's only when every automated gate passes AND G4 (the PM's own test-session photos, checked offline) passes. py/gates.py applies these numbers; bin/60-gates.sh produces the measurements.

G1.what: Character error rate (CER, %) per line, held-out line sets (other seeds), integer model in tesseract.js 7.0.0 with the rider's settings but page segmentation 7 (one line per image); never worse than Doubango on the same set

G2.what: Wrong reads that pass every check digit, on synthetic documents from a renderer and seeds training never saw, through the real rider pipeline (tesseract.js 7.0.0, page segmentation 6)
G2.note: countCorrectionCaused: true counts every wrong-but-valid read, as the rider would see it. Some come from the shared look-alike correction, not the model (a real K before fillers in optional data becomes '<', which no check digit can see): the report lists them separately. Set it to false to judge the model alone.
G2.decision: 2026-10-14: judge the model alone. A K and a '<' weigh the same in every ICAO check digit (K=20, a multiple of 10), so the shared corrector's choice to read a K at the start of an empty optional-data run as a misread filler can make a real K disappear without any check failing. That is a property of the corrector (kept: a '<' misread as K is far more common), it only touches optional data, which no decision uses, and it affects every model equally. The report still lists these reads separately.

G3.what: No worse than Doubango on the same documents

fixtures.what: The repository's own MRZ fixtures read as apps/rider/src/mrz/reader.fixtures.test.ts expects (6/6)

size.what: Integer model, gzipped, as the rider downloads it

G4.what: The PM's own test-session photos, read offline on the phone pipeline before switching: valid rate at least Doubango's and zero wrong-but-valid. Manual (photos never leave the test project).
